# Script your hosting, or hand it to an AI agent

The dashboard is a client of the public API, so anything you click you can script. AI agents get the same tools through the MCP server.

## What is included

- ### Every action is an endpoint

Sites, environments, domains, backups, and billing all have API endpoints, described in an OpenAPI file.
- ### Scoped API keys

Name each key and give it scopes, an expiry, and an IP allowlist. The secret is shown once.
- ### MCP server

Connect Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, or ChatGPT to mcp.wpwaterfall.com with OAuth sign in and no API key. It acts as you and never does more than your role allows.
- ### Confirm guards

Tools that delete, reset, deploy, or roll back need a confirmation, so a vague prompt cannot destroy a site.
- ### Jobs you can follow

Every server change runs as a job with events. Follow it with server-sent events or polling.
- ### Audited like people

Agent actions appear in the activity log with the key that made them.

## What does a script get?

- Problem Details errors with a request ID to quote
- Idempotency keys on every write
- 600 requests a minute per key, with rate limit headers
- Cursor pagination on every list

## Start with one site. Add more when you need them.
